messages.message: Hi! I'm at the Orchard Central main entrance, wearing a blue dress. White Toyota Vios right?
Yes that's me! I can see you, coming now. 1 min.
Great thanks! Heading to Changi T3, my flight is at 3:30pm.
Sure, no problem. We will get there in time.
Hey, are we going the right way? This doesn't look like the usual route to the airport.
Don't worry, I know the way. We will reach on time.

payload.driver_response_content: Don't worry, I know the way. We will reach on time.
payload.analysis: The rider explicitly queried the route at 13:24 (MSG-005) after noticing the deviation near Shenton Way / Nicoll Highway. The driver's response (MSG-006) was dismissive and did not explain the reason for the deviation (PIE traffic). At no point did the driver proactively inform the rider of a route change or cite traffic conditions. This constitutes a failure to meet the driver's notification obligation under ride-hailing policy.

events.stretch: PIE Exit 16 (Cactus / PAYA LEBAR) to Exit 11 (TAMPINES RD)
events.description: Vehicle fire on PIE eastbound between Paya Lebar and Hougang. Lanes 1 and 2 blocked. Heavy congestion and long delays reported from 13:05.

events.road: PIE exit ramp — Changi Airport exit
events.description: Heavy congestion on PIE near the airport exit, likely a secondary effect of the vehicle fire upstream.
ECP eastbound flowing smoothly. No incidents. The driver's reroute through ECP was a reasonable alternative given PIE conditions.

alternative_routes_available: ECP via Nicoll Hwy / Geylang (driver's choice)
Regional routes via Sims Ave / Tanjong Katong
payload.reroute_reason: A vehicle fire on PIE eastbound at 13:05 (10 minutes before pickup) made the optimal route impassable for much of the trip window. The driver's decision to reroute via Nicoll Hwy → Geylang → ECP was a reasonable and safety-motivated alternative.
payload.notification_gap: The driver did not proactively inform the rider of the route change or the reason (PIE traffic). When the rider explicitly asked about the route at 13:24, the driver's response was dismissive and did not explain the traffic situation.
payload.policy_reference: RydeResolve Driver Policy §4.2: 'Drivers must inform the rider of any route deviation from the system-recommended route and the reason for the deviation before or at the point of deviation. Failure to notify renders the driver liable for excess fare charges attributable to the unnotified deviation.'

events.details: Rider R-7823 booked trip TRIP-2026-09945 from Tiong Bahru Plaza to VivoCity. Scheduled pickup 08:45.
Driver D-2398 (Lim Wei Ming, Honda HR-V SGP 4521 M) assigned. ETA 13 min.
Driver started navigating to pickup location. Live tracking enabled.
Driver GPS within 10m of pickup point. Speed 0 km/h. Auto-arrival confirmed.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Free wait timer started. 5 min free wait period ends at 08:48.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 22s, no answer.
Free 5-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded. Cancellation fee now applicable per policy.
No-show threshold (8 min) reached. $5.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (e-wallet).
Driver D-2398 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).
